scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start:db: (docker start dev-postgres-hqg 2>/dev/null || docker run --name dev-postgres-hqg -e POSTGRES_USER=hqg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpass -e POSTGRES_DB=hqg_dashboard -p 5432:5432 -v hqg-dashboard-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data -d postgres:16)
scripts.reset:db: docker rm -f dev-postgres-hqg && docker volume rm hqg-dashboard-pgdata
scripts.prod: npm run build:frontend && npm run start:backend
